say:1:1320925001:0.text: Sir, we've brought the wood! Is this enough?
say:1:1320925001:0.source_cn: 大叔，我们收集到你要的硬松木了！这些应该足够了吧？

say:2:1320925002:1.text: Looks good. Give me a little time, making coffin isn't quick work.
say:2:1320925002:1.source_cn: 差不多刚好。行了，你们等一会吧，制作棺材得要一点时间。

say:3:1320925003:1.text: *Sigh* What a long night this has been...

narration:4:1320925004:0.text: After some time and hard work, the tomb guardian finishes the new coffin and helps you open Ksenia's grave.
narration:4:1320925004:0.source_cn: 一阵忙碌后，巡墓人终于做好了新棺材，并且帮你们打开了克...

say:5:1320925005:1.text: You were right, the old coffin really couldn't be salvaged.
say:5:1320925005:1.source_cn: 你们判断的没错，这口旧棺材确实没法再用了。

say:6:1320925006:1.text: I'll take care of transferring the remains to the new coffin. You can gather her belongings and grave goods. It's best to <style="highlight">pack everything in this bag</style> for easy transport.
say:6:1320925006:1.source_cn: 我负责把尸骨挪到新棺材里，这些遗物和随葬品就交给你们收...
